name: Mário Frias
place: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

credits.title: Dark Horse
credits.overview: Follows Jair Messias Bolsonaro, a man driven by his political career after disappointment with the direction of his country, in the journey to become the 38th president of Brazil.

credits.title: A Colisão dos Destinos
credits.overview: From childhood to the presidency of Brazil, the documentary follows Jair Bolsonaro’s trajectory, tracing his background, military career, and the path that led to his political rise.

credits.title: Urban Chronicles
credits.overview: Five looks from the same man deal with the love, betrayal, fear, anguish, terror and justice that happen every day in the lives of all of us. Urban Chronicles shows that real life in the city can be much wilder than the existence of beasts in the wild.

credits.title: Floribella - The Musical
credits.overview: In the musical, Flor and her band travel to the kingdom of Krikoragán on tour, arriving there they find a sad Count who wins Flor's heart, but it is clear that Delfina will not allow Flor's happiness and does everything to prevent this love. Floribella - The Musical, is a "Musical spin-off" of the soap opera Floribella
